field_guide.symbols: One record per original linear address, sorted; includes every discovered function and named data/code label.
field_guide.status: Authoritative published state, only for functions; never inferred from implementation/test links.
field_guide.instructions: Per-function count; functions can overlap, so these counts must not be summed for unique coverage.
field_guide.roadmap: Specific subsystem identifier in subsystems; every function is assigned, including runtime and provisional analysis work.
field_guide.notes: All distinct original analysis notes, including historical descriptions that still need review.
field_guide.implementation: Documented native source paths, not a claim that every path implements the complete function.
field_guide.tests: Documented test source paths; exact scope and exclusions remain in notes and linked technical documentation.
field_guide.review: Non-authoritative historical discrepancies; legacy_value is evidence, not a second operative state.
field_guide.coverage: Unique coverage snapshot computed from original instruction addresses and authoritative function states. Refresh after state/count changes.
field_guide.classification: Per-function area assignment, not a port-state promotion. confidence=documented (existing symbol/notes/task), inferred (static calls/data/instructions), unresolved (work queue, not a resolved semantic identification). Evidence references linear LE addresses; previous_roadmap preserves the superseded coarse task.
field_guide.subsystems: Leaf subsystem titles and scope used by catalog queries and dashboard; no inferred percentages of whole-system fidelity.
field_guide.milestones: Ordered execution milestones H0..Hn; entry points and deferrals drive the static dependency closure computed by tools/function_catalog.py plan.
field_guide.treatment: Subsystem default of how a function is satisfied: port (faithful C port), equivalent (observable behavior/output reproduced without a line-by-line port), native (replaced by host/platform code), not-needed (no counterpart in the port).
field_guide.calls: Measured direct `call imm` targets that are catalog functions; refreshed by disasm.py catalog --refresh.
field_guide.pointer_refs: Measured function starts used as instruction operands (callbacks/pointer registration); indirect calls are not resolved.
field_guide.data_referenced: Measured: the function start is stored in data (dispatch or callback table).
field_guide.plan: Optional reviewed per-function override of treatment and/or milestone, with its rationale.

migration.policy: Preserve every published function state/name/task and every legacy annotation; do not silently promote or downgrade functions.
legacy_comments: # address  name  [notes]  -- identified functions/data in MAINDOS.EXE

H0.goal: Reconciliar código, catálogo y tareas; registrar las pruebas relevantes con revisión, datos, binario y argumentos.

H1.title: Referencia integrada DOS
H1.goal: Captura corta y reproducible del original en carrera con mapeo LE, estado inicial, entradas y cadencia de tick confirmados.

H2.title: Cadena de simulación fiel
H2.goal: Controles, dispatcher de coches, física, IA y consultas de pista portados por bloques y comparables con el original.
H2.criteria: Escenarios integrados con campos y tolerancias declarados sin divergencias inexplicadas; desviaciones documentadas.
